card.name: Digits just before metric units
card.fires_on: A digit inside a number right before a metric unit such as km, mm, m, nm or cm, often in a distance or size given after an imperial measure or in parentheses.

modes.label: Distance in km
modes.description: Digit in a converted distance written in parentheses after miles.
modes.example: a mere five miles (<<8>> km) north of the Connecticut border

modes.label: Size or wavelength
modes.description: Digit within a number before mm, m or nm.

modes.label: Spacing in cm or mg
modes.description: Digit in a dose or spacing figure just before a unit.
modes.example: inject each 200‑mg injection at least <<5>> cm (approximately 2 inches) apart

card.writes: It suppresses broken-character output and promotes non-breaking space characters, which fit the gap before a unit.
card.plain: It fires on the digits of a measurement just before a unit like km, mm or cm.
